## The data $\times$ analysis matrix

#| label: matrix

repeatability_matrix()

::: {.src}
@AlipourfardEtAl2021SystematizingConfidenceOpen; @NosekEtAl2025BriefGlossaryTerms
:::

::: notes
This grid holds the workshop's vocabulary, and everything that follows refers back to it. The question stays the same throughout, and what varies is the data and the analysis. The same data with the same analysis is reproducibility, which asks whether rerunning your recipe gives your number. The same data with a different but justifiable analysis is robustness, which asks whether your finding survives other defensible choices. New data for the same question is replicability. The fourth cell, new data with a new analysis, is generalisation, which we leave aside today.
:::
